mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assets (id, project_id, shot_id, asset_type, name, file_path, mime_type, file_size, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{shotId}, #{assetType}, #{name}, #{filePath}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM assets WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
